document.abstract: This standard describes an interface for a general purpose fiber optic connector for interconnection of television equipment. For information on testing for physically demanding applications, the reader is directed to the informative references listed in annex B. The connectors may find use in a variety of other signal transmission applications. The design accommodates both single mode and multimode optical fibers. — The standard defines connectors that are hermaphroditic by construction, allowing cable plugs to mate with like cable plugs as well as bulkhead receptacles, while maintaining polarization. — Separate physical packaging design objectives will result in the availability of both cable and bulkhead connectors for installation in harsh environments. — Connector and optical termini adhering to the limits of the interfacial dimensions of this standard will inter-mate. Applicable tolerances to the basic dimensions shall be such that the combined value of these tolerances shall not exceed the limit described in note 5.
